Today we have been fortunate enough to find another power who shares a similar view to us, the Confederacy of Lamandica. We believe that such a transfer would serve the long-term stability and prosperity of Vespurias as a whole, and would align with the broader goal of regional decolonization. At the same time, we would not want Lamandica to suffer a loss as a result of this process. Lamandica has invested considerable effort and resources into developing the colony to its current state, and that contribution should be fairly recognized.

Therefore in exchange for the South Vespurian territory, the Federation of Luscaria is prepared to offer $25 billion, paid over a period of five years to the Confederacy of Lamandica.

[quote=the_paldean_union;61015377][b]Fuego y furia | Erene: 2000 | Kingdom of Paldea[/b]

"You know, my father...my father fought in the Islas Kikatami War."

Secretary-General Benjamín Garrido says addressing the National Assembly, and the thousands of paldeans hearing his words through a loudspeaker outside, along with the millions watching at home on TV, he stands in his military uniform as always, clean-shaven, and with a stern tone he continues.

"He told me, "son, don't you ever forget what we fought there for" was the first thing he said when he returned infact. I believe it was those words that led me to enlist in the armed service, to go to the officer academy in Los Angeles, and fight my way to the Secretary-General. What did we fight for there? Anti-Colonialism, the Islas Kikatami War was about anti-colonialism, and restoring the natural borders of our great kingdom. 

Our Kingdom is, and always has been, therefore, a bulwark of national sovereignty and self-determination; 2,308 of our people died for it in 1983. We must fight for it. Across erene exists a series of brutal occupations by larger nations aimed at expanding their power. Like rain, it irrigates these imperialist powers, fueling their evil and diabolical might, while drowning the vast millions who suffer under the occupation. Some will go so far as to suggest that these colonies are "an integral part of their nation" or "autonomous", or various other terms aimed at downplaying or denying the truth of the situation.

The Kingdom of Paldea, must then stand for the self-determination of all people across Erene, whether they be Vespurian, Shamite, Argosian, or Kinzaouian. To those who stand with us in this righteous cause, we offer camaraderie, to the oppressed millions, we will offer not only our words, but our guns and might and to the occupiers, we promise you nothing but Fire and Fury should we confront you."

The National Assembly stands up and claps until the Secretary-General raises his hand for silence; all of them uniformly sit back down and prepare to listen once more

"If we are to start our crusade against the forces of imperialism. We must first start with the most obvious and egregious example currently existing today on our continent. Islas Kikatami has ALWAYS been Paldean. Regardless of its current status as a colony belonging to Rosenmarkke under "international law" and a "non governing territroy." It is by NATURAL LAW that it become paldean once more, that the blue, white, blue flag flies over its shores for all time. Every day that Islas Kikatami exists under occupation is another day where Paldea is robbed of its rightful territory.

However, this will be no more. Today. I ask you, the National Assembly of the Kingdom of Paldea, to adopt a resolution that will authorize the deployment of the Royal Army once more to Islas Kikatami! This will not be an invasion, or whatever the international community will call it, standing in their ivory towers. It will be a grand reconquest and liberation. Here we stand at an opportunity to erase the national shame of the 1983 War, to avenge the martyrs lost at the hands of devils...

Soon, we will be one nation again.

Long live the Kingdom!

For God! King! and Fatherland!"

The entire National Assembly erupts into screams of YES! rows of clapping and cheering as the Secretary-General steps off stage.

[Spoiler=Ley 27.735 "RESOLUTION ON ISLAS KITKAMI AND AUTHORIZATION OF THE USE OF MILITARY FORCES AGAINST THE REPUBLIC OF ROSENMARKKE"]

[b]An Act To[/b]

Denounce the occupation of Islas Kitakami by the Republic of Rosenmarkke in the form in which it currently exists, that being a colony. Recognize the violation of the territorial integrity of the Kingdom of Paldea, and to give a continuing authorization for the use of military force against the Republic of Rosenmarkke 

[b]Exercising its duty under the Royal Constitution of the Kingdom of Paldea, and in the best intrest of the people of Paldea, the National Assembly does hearby declare:[/b]

Section 1: Declaration

Recognizing, that the current state of Islas Kikatami is a non-self-governing territory, or in other words, a colony of the Rosenmarkke State.

Declaring, that the Republic of Rosenmarkke current occupation of Islas Kikatami is illegal, exploitative, contrary to the Kingdom of Paldea's territorial integrity, and a violation of the basic rights of all peoples, among those being self-determination and the right to nationhood.

Declaring, that the official position of the Kingdom of Paldea is and has always been that Islas Kikatami is a rightful province of the Kingdom of Paldea, and has been since the independence of the nation. 

Thus, the Kingdom of Paldea declares that hostilities exist between the Republic of Rosenmarkke and the Kingdom of Paldea.

Section 2: Authorization

2.1| The Ministry of Forigen Affairs is hereby ordered to undertake the following by the National Assembly within the next 7 days
[list]
[*]2.1a| Inform the Government of the Republic of Rosenmarkke that a state of hostilities has been declared against them by the Kingdom of Paldea, and that the Kingdom of Paldea no longer recognizes any legal authority they possess over the Islas Kitakami. And that thusly, that diplomatic relations between them and the Kingdom of Paldea are hereby suspended indefinitely. 

[*]2.1b| Commence the expulsion and deportation of all diplomatic personnel from the Republic of Rosenmarkke back to their country from the sovereign territory of the Kingdom of Paldea and the Provinces of Callista.

[*]2.1c| Withdraw the Paldean ambassador and their staff from the Republic of Rosenmarkke.

[*]2.1d| Suspend all travel to and from the Republic of Rosenmarkke. All Rosenmarkkean nationals within the borders of the Kingdom of Paldea without a valid immigration status will be ordered to leave the country within 48 hours or be placed under arrest and deported.

2.2| The Ministry of Commerce is hearby orderred to undertake the following by the National Assembly within the next 7 days
[list]
[*]2.2a| Declare that a state of embargo exists between the Kingdom of Paldea and the Republic of Rosenmarkke, and therefore, all trade or other commercial activity with the Republic of Rosenmarkke, or companies and businesses housed or based in the Republic of Rosenmarkke, is hereby suspended indefinitely. 

[*]2.2b| Any merchant ships currently docked within the ports of the Kingdom of Paldea registered under the Rosenmarkkean flag will be forbidden from leaving their port until further notice, and their crews will be deported back to their country of origin. Any Rosenmarkkean ships within Paldean Waters are ordered to leave, or dock in Paldean Ports within the next 12 hours; any ship that fails to do so will be forcefully escorted by the Paldean Navy to a port.

[*]2.2c| All financial or property assets within the Kingdom of Paldea belonging to the Republic of Rosenmarkke, including assets within the National Bank of Paldea are hereby seized and put under the ownership of the Royal Fund.

[/list]

2.3 The Ministry of Defense, Secretariat, Office of the Secretary-General, and all component offices are hereby authorized to use the Paldean Royal Army and all necessary force within the bounds of international law to resolve the hostilities with the Republic of Rosenmarkke.

2.4 The provisions above will expire upon the cessation of hostilities between the Kingdom of Paldea and the Republic of Rosenmarkke. Which will be declared by the Secretary-General in an address to the National Assembly unless specified otherwise in future acts.

This motion is put to the floor of the National Assembly for voting.

[Spoiler=Operation Little Paladin]

With the formalities of democracy out of the way, the national assembly came to a unanimous yes vote only an hour after the Secretary-General's speech. The Royal Rule Assistance Council and the Joint Royal Staff Office began the process of planning military operations within Kikatami . Named "Little Paladin," The general aims of the invasion, as devised by the Joint Royal Staff Office, were a rapid air campaign to eliminate the garrison's ability to defend the colony, its air and ground assets, and major infrastructure that could be used to respond to an invasion, and secure complete Paldean Air Superiority above the islands. Followed quickly by a simultaneous Airborne-Amphibious operation to secure a beachhead, and then follow-up forces would land in secured ports and sweep up any remaining resistance supported by constant close air support. Hopefully, the Joint Royal Staff Office argued that an invasion would take less than 2 to 3 weeks. This was, however, far easier said than done. The Royal Navy could, hypothetically, support the invasion force in full logistically, having plenty of Assault Ships, Underway Replenishment, Cargo, and its so far unused converted Troopships. However, the actual airpower it could bring to the operation was minimal. The Royal Army was fully ready to go, with its planned contribution already fully activated forces who could begin boarding transports within hours.

The Royal Air Force was a logistical mess; it simply did not have the long-range strike capability that the Joint Royal Staff Office was requesting from it. While it did have in-depth plans to use air to air refulers to ferry its aircraft to and from the mainland to Islas Kikatami in case of a second war, this was relying on callistan airbases, which were decently far from the islands. Additionally, the RUP-76 was from the 1970s, and alot of the aircraft were beginning to show their age via reliability issues. While a replacement was being planned for introduction by 2028, it could not be rushed into service fast enough for the invasion. It was feared that extensive use could make the remaining RUP-76s completely give out, requiring a full pull from service for maintenance, a situation that would be deadly if it happened in the middle of a strike mission. Regardless, the Royal Air Force would devise a plan to rotate continuously the RUP-76s deployed for the mission and to have maintenance crews on 24/7 shifts at the Orélie-Antoine afb in southern Callista.

While military planning was ongoing, the Secretariat moved to the domestic situation. While support for the war was high, as the Secretariat had crafted a story of revanchism post war. The media would still be weaponized; now airing on the news every day, with dramatized reports of Rosemarkkean colonial brutality, interviews with military analysts who repeated one message: the only way to liberate these paldeans from the brutality of their occupiers was through a Paldean military intervention. Meanwhile, across Paldean Social Media, nationalist and large mouthpiece accounts began signal-boosting the same message. Within the following days, many Paldeans would begin to protest infront of the Rosemarkkean Embassy, demanding a withdrawal from the colony and an end to the genocide of the native Paldeans. 

With the population now mostly in support of the war, assets began to be staged in the area near Kiakami. The 1st Carrier Strike Group would leave its base at Los Angeles and stage 10 kms outside of the EEZ of the Rosenmmarkee within the Kikatami. The intended landing forces would begin boarding the ARP Orélie-Antoine and ARP Achille Laviarde. Along with the other ambitious assault ships of the Paldean Navy, although they wouldn't depart just yet, the Surface Action Group would escort them to the islands when the signal to begin transferring over forces was given by the  Joint Royal Staff. Meanwhile, the submarine detachment would leave and remain within the Paldean EEZ, ready to strike out at the first sign of the movement of Rosemarkkean naval forces. The limited Palestinian satellite infrastructure would begin monitoring the movement of military forces around the island, while the air force would also move to staging bases in callistan southern airbases.

[b]The Marquet Islands Crisis: Paldea declares hostilities: June 6, 2027[/b]

It had not been a good morning at the head government offices of Rosenmarkke, a declaration of war over the island of Montesque had been made by the Paldean state, in an echo of the 1985 war for the Island that had seen a decisive Rosenmarkket victory.

However, times had changed, the Island had changed, and Paldea had grown stronger, at least according to field reports given to the triumvirate and the Patriotic Defense Council the day prior by the SCSID southern command, located on the island in question.

We knew this was coming, Paldea has been straining at the leash for years internally to claim the Islands, stated chief consul Consantin Alexandrii-Porgyros IV, a thin and bright eyed antlered Thrømm.

But the Island doesnt technically belong to Rosenmarkke, intoned second consul Phillipe Belgarde, a fine haired montfleurois  It was sold to Surarctic Oil in 1990, at least the fields were, 

We couldve used that excuse in the 90s and placated the world, unfortunately that will not fly, stated 
Polenne Strømm the third consul, a brown haired female in a checkered skirt suit, I believe we must approach this diplomatically, but with a hand of steel, the Island must remain Rosenmarkket,

Yet, we risk a war thousands of miles away from our borders, on an Island that we can most certainly see being overrun and circled, replied Belgarde.

But, Polenne has a point, the Island is a keystone in our energy independence policy, if we lose it, we lose our ability to ensure our citizens have access to cheap energy, replied Consantin.

Drat it! Where is the head of the SCSID? Intoned Belgarde, smacking his hand on the wooden table.

64% of the Island, my dear triumvirate is Paldean in ethnic origin, spoke a voice quickly identified as Rutherford Menkins head of the nation's most powerful intelligence organization the SCSID, Thus, I advise that a middle ground be found, he continued, walking from the corner of the room, his robes shuffling over the floor.

And this middle ground is? Enquired Belgarde inclining his head at Menkins.

The plan is simple, elegant, my dear consul, replied Menkins, We firstly acknowledge our claim to the island is built upon old principles of colonialism, we then reframe our current position on the Island as fluid, we must appear amicable, he paused waiting for further comment, and when none was to be found he continued, We then move quickly to have a natural referendum, though in this we put no mention of joining paldea, instead, we move the island towards joint handling,

So a condominium General Menkins? Stated Polenne.

Precisely, by making the Island neither fully theirs or fully ours we are able to negate the issue of colonialism altogether in favour of autonomous joint control, replied Menkins.

It is a good plan, but how can we convince the Paldean junta to accept? Enquired Consantin, stroking his chin musingly.

Dialogue, it begins with an olive branch, I shall order the six frigates that we have stationed there to be removed from the Island, say 140 miles away to where we shall put our first carrier strike group, in the event things go wrong we launch our group, if things go right we retain our distance. Replied Menkins.

And then, we offer to host a meeting between paldean officials and Rosenmarkke representatives, stated Belgarde enthusiastically, It is peak diplomacy! 

Not Rosenmarkket officials Mr. Belgarde, stated Polenne sharply, Island officials, the duchess and her court, she stated, It permits us to produce the veneer of autonomy, 

Precisely madame consul, replied Menkins.

Very well then, we shall take a vote on this and release a statement, replied Consantin, clearing his throat, Thank you General Menkins, 

Menkins nodded, bowed, and then moved out of the chamber silently where the vote was then quickly taken, a few hours later a statement would be released, not by the government of Rosenmarkke but by the government of the island, by the office of the Duchess Radovna Melchjyonék.

[b]The Dictat of Montesque: 2025[/b]

Whereas the government of the Island of Montesque has been alarmed and disturbed by the actions taken by the Paldean state, but even more appalled at the presence of the Rosenmarkket colonisers, the citizens and the government of the Island hereby call upon the governments of Paldea and Rosenmarkke to form an agreement of peace that shall prosper the good people of Kikitami, wherein the duchess and her government calls for the removal of colonial military assets to promote peace, and invites both parties to speak their mind in the presence of the government of Montesque.

-The Government of Montesque



The dictat was carefully worded to ensure that all points on Paldeas side were neutralised while also neutralising the military presence of Rosenmarkke, at least the visible presence, which would see the five frigates of the fleet there move silently out of port and away from the Island, followed by several nightime jets of soldiers and military officials, though the southern command remained.

In the meantime the SCSID quietly moved among its civilian assets to prepare for a potentially grinding war should negotiations fail, arming and ensuring guerilla operations could be put in place rapidly.
